summary.name: Spikes Studio
summary.one_liner: Spikes Studio is an AI video editor that finds the best moments in long videos and turns them into short-form clips for YouTube, TikTok, Twitch and Reels.
use_cases: Turning long YouTube or stream recordings into short clips
Creating vertical clips for TikTok and Reels
Scheduling clips to LinkedIn, TikTok, Facebook or YouTube
Finding engaging moments in podcasts or interviews
summary.what_it_does: The AI editor identifies segments in uploaded videos that are likely to hold attention and turns them into clips. The page says the editor handles videos up to 5 minutes through the 'Add Captions' tab, with captions, vertical reframing, auto-effects, and a generated title, description and suggested hashtags. It transcribes speech in 99+ languages and can connect social accounts to schedule posts and view analytics from one dashboard. The page also describes engagement analytics and platform-specific optimization, though these claims are stated in marketing terms.
notable: AI moment detection for finding highlights in long videos
Captions, vertical reframing and generated titles/hashtags
Social account connection with scheduling and analytics
caveats: Free plan adds a watermark; removing it requires a paid subscription
The clip editor tab is limited to videos up to 5 minutes
Free users get limited extra minutes via referrals and onboarding
